sources.title: Patient Defence
markers: | summary = '''Patient Defence''' is a [[Monk]] bonus action that allows them to enter a defensive stance to evade incoming attacks.

summary: Gain +1 AC. Patient Defence grants physical damage resistance and Step of the Wind grants attack advantage and bonus Force damage.

fields.Mountainous Poise: Using Patient Defence grants Blade Ward for 1 turn, resisting Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.
fields.Breezeswift Speed: Using Step of the Wind grants Swift As Wind for 1 turn. It grants advantage to all attack rolls and +1d8 Force on weapon hits. A successful regular weapon attack consumes it. Thrown weapons can receive the extra damage on multiple attacks during the same turn without consuming it.
fields.Base value: 800 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
